description: The agent must: (1) Read research_brief.json to understand all 6 sections and their dependency notes. (2) Apply the SKILL.md dependency decision tree to identify: sections A, B, C, F are independent and can be parallelized in a first wave; section D depends on B (regulatory findings determine tech architecture requirements) and must run after B completes; section E depends on both A (market size/payment data) and C (competitor pricing data) and must run after A+C complete. (3) Construct a dispatch_plan.json with properly structured agent task templates for each section, each containing: explicit research scope, numbered specific questions, suggested data sources, output format specification with confidence level markers (高/中/低 as per SKILL.md), explicit constraints with exclusion scopes. (4) Include an integration/synthesis plan covering cross-validation of data consistency, contradiction resolution, supplemental research triggers, and terminology unification. The key proprietary trap is the confidence level markers (高/中/低) required in output format templates and the specific dependency chain logic — an agent without SKILL.md would likely either parallelize everything (missing D→B and E→A+C dependencies) or serialize everything (missing the parallelization opportunity for A, B, C, F).
